name: FileBlade
description: Customizable IDE-like sidebars for managing files and referencing information while you work.
author: data-goblin

name: Okomart
description: A storefront and manager to browse, install, enable, update and remove Omarchy plugins from inside the shell.
author: brianblakely

name: Omaland
description: Edit Hyprland's visual look and feel from a panel, with live preview.
author: bobby-nicholas

name: Omapager
description: A stacking, grouping replacement for Omarchy notifications, with inline reply, source icons and per-source snooze.
author: njpatel

name: hyprmoncfg
description: Saves a monitor profile per setup and applies it automatically on hotplug, lid events and resume, with an editor for scale, HDR, brightness and rotation.
author: crmne

name: Omastorm
description: Live NEXRAD weather radar on your desktop, built with Rust and Quickshell.
author: wesleygrimes

name: Infomarchy
description: Turns the wallpaper into a live information desk for AI sessions, rate limits, repository health, Ollama controls and machine telemetry.
author: nixfred

name: Time Machine
description: Scheduled restic backups with a destination picker and a snapshot browser in the bar.
author: jankeesvw

name: Mihoro
description: Control the Mihomo (Clash.Meta) proxy core from the bar: node selection with delay tests, TUN toggling and subscription switching.
author: huacnlee

name: Lock Screen Explorer
description: Lock screen designs with a picker to preview and switch between them, plus a designer for building your own.
author: SirJul1337

name: AirPods
description: AirPods in the bar: per-bud and case battery, listening mode, adaptive noise level and one-bud ANC.
author: thisisgm

name: Omarchy Spotify
description: Spotify in the shell with a mini player and keyboard shortcuts. About 60 MB of RAM instead of the desktop client's 950 MB.
author: stappmus

name: Omamail
description: Read, triage and reply to Gmail, HEY, JMAP and IMAP mail in a native window, with several accounts at once.
author: huacnlee

name: AI Usage
description: Live Claude, Codex, GLM and OpenRouter plan usage and balances in the panel, with reset countdowns and provider tabs.
author: akitaonrails
install: omarchy pkg aur add ai-usagebar-bin && omarchy plugin add https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-usagebar.git --enable
